Return by Friday
He returns the tape ten years late. The question at the end is still waiting.
In closing week at a video store, a lost student monster movie comes back with a question hidden after the credits that nobody answered ten years ago.

Eli's video store closes Sunday. On Monday, Marcus, who now screams professionally for horror films, returns the only copy of the terrible short they made at twenty-one, ten years overdue. After the credits sits a hand-lettered card that Marcus once mistook for a shoot schedule. You decide whether Eli says it in the present tense this time, keeps it as a fond memory, or lets the store close on a clean goodbye.
A regular with a membership card from 2014, here to rent something for the last week.
